## Guidelines
- All pages use hreflang for language alternates (symmetric + x-default)
- Each page includes schema.org TouristAttraction/TouristDestination JSON-LD markup
- RTL support for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu
- SEO-optimized meta titles and descriptions per language
- Real geocoordinates and Google Maps deep links on every page
